params.body:
The README, read against the code. Only stale claims corrected and missing essentials added; language and structure kept. Every change with the file and line that justifies it:

# README review: Trendwolves/glk-transferor

Reviewed at commit 7e66c03 (2026-09-10). Language and structure of the README kept; only stale claims corrected and missing essentials added.

## Stale, corrected

- `Speech\Jargon` does not exist; the class is `App\Services\Conversation\Jargon` (app/Services/Conversation/Jargon.php, namespace line; no `App\Speech` anywhere under app/). The 224-token budget claim is still true (Jargon.php line 24).
- Route table was incomplete and silent about the login. `/`, `/inzichten` and the new `/catalogus` and `/fiche/{worksheet}` sit behind `auth` middleware; `/aanmelden` is the office login, `/afmelden` the logout; the worker path is `/werf` then `/werf/fiche` (routes/web.php lines 15 to 55).
- Open item "Echte inlog. Nu volstaat een code van zes tekens" reads as if the whole tool has no login. The office now has email plus password (routes/web.php, app/Livewire/Office/Login.php, app/Console/Commands/MakeOfficeUser.php `office:user`); only the worker still uses a six-character code (app/Livewire/Site/SignIn.php line 11). Reworded to "Echte inlog voor de ploeg" with that split.

## Missing, added

- Setup: `php artisan office:user <email>` after seeding, without it nobody can enter `/` (app/Console/Commands/CheckDeployment.php `access()`: "geen enkele gebruiker, dus niemand raakt binnen. Draai office:user"; MakeOfficeUser.php).
- Setup: PHP 8.4 or higher, Node 22, Laravel 13, Livewire 4 (composer.json require `php ^8.4`, `laravel/framework ^13.31.0`, `livewire/livewire ^4.4.4`; .github/workflows/test.yml php-version '8.4', node-version '22'). `composer dev` as the combined dev runner (composer.json scripts.dev).
- Setup: the second conversation provider. `CONVERSATION_PROVIDER=elevenlabs` with `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`, `ELEVENLABS_AGENT_ID`, `ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID`, and `php artisan conversation:sync` after any tool-schema change (config/worksheets.php `conversation.providers.elevenlabs`; app/Console/Commands/SyncConversationAgent.php; .env.example names). The README only mentioned ElevenLabs for the `/werf/vlaams` trial.
- Setup: demo login switch `OFFICE_DEMO_LOGIN` and `OFFICE_DEMO_EMAIL` (config/worksheets.php `office` block; .env.example; tests/Feature/OfficeAccessTest.php lines 135 and 152).
- `werkfiches:check`: what else it checks (catalogue, crew, office user, HTTPS, debug flag on a public URL) (CheckDeployment.php `catalogue()`, `access()`, `https()`).
- Tests: the suite also covers office access, security headers, the Elixir endpoint and the build stamp (tests/Feature/OfficeAccessTest.php, SecurityHeadersTest.php, ElixirEndpointTest.php, BuildStampTest.php); it runs without any API key on a fixed APP_KEY and in-memory SQLite (phpunit.xml lines 26 to 33).
- CI: .github/workflows/test.yml runs on push to main and every pull request, against MySQL 8 and PHP 8.4, then `pint --test`, then `npm ci && npm run build` separately. Rationale copied from the workflow comments (mp3 bytes in a utf8mb4 cache column, 8.4 as the floor).
- Environments: staging is the only environment, `https://glk-transferor.on-forge.com` (elixir.json). Added under "Uitrollen".
- New section "Wat Elixir leest": `elixir.json`; `/up` (bootstrap/app.php line 13 `health: '/up'`); `/.well-known/build.json` from `App\Elixir\BuildStamp`, 404 without a checkout (app/Elixir/ElixirServiceProvider.php, BuildStamp.php); `/api/elixir` behind `ELIXIR_TOKEN` with the app-specific `conversation` probe (config/elixir.php `extra`, app/Elixir/ConversationHealth.php, ElixirController.php line 33 to 35); `elixir:beat` every minute as the only scheduled task (routes/console.php); `.github/workflows/elixir-fix.yml` (reusable workflow from abovebeyond-ai/elixir-fix) and `.github/workflows/evidence.yml` (abovebeyond-ai/control-verify-action on `elixir/` branches).

## Verified and left as is

- Catalogue counts 227 materieel and 2.533 artikelen (database/catalogue/materieel.json and artikelen.json, counted).
- `migrate --seed` seeds catalogue (machines, articles, sites) and crew (database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php, CatalogueSeeder.php `sites()`); DemoSeeder exists.
- `niet_geweten` field name (app/Http/Controllers/ConversationController.php line 88).
- Jargon orders sites by most recent lines (Jargon.php line 60 `orderByDesc('lines_max_created_at')`).
- Only-live decision of 14 August 2026 and its costs match config/worksheets.php and routes/web.php comments.

## Surprises, not changed in the README

- composer.json requires `anthropic-ai/sdk ^0.40.0` but nothing under app/, config/, routes/ or database/ references Anthropic. Likely a leftover from the removed reading path; a dependency the code does not use is still installed and scanned.
- DEPLOY.md says "PHP 8.3 of hoger" and "2707 artikelen"; composer.json says `^8.4` and the JSON holds 2.533 articles. DEPLOY.md was outside the brief, so it was left alone.
- DEPLOY.md still points the Elixir token at `/opt/hub-jobs/app-tokens/glk-transferor`; per the workspace CLAUDE.md that path moved to `/home/elixir/elixir-secrets/app-tokens/`. Not a README claim, so not touched.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
